00048 FFTEngineInternal::FFTEngineInternal(const int fftSizeToUse) throw()
00049 : fftSize(Bits::isPowerOf2(fftSizeToUse) ? fftSizeToUse : Bits::nextPowerOf2(fftSizeToUse)),
00050   fftSizeHalved(fftSize>>1),
00051   fftSizeBytes(fftSize * sizeof(float)),
00052   fftSizeHalvedBytes(fftSizeHalved * sizeof(float)),
00053   ifftScaling(1.f/(float)fftSize),
00054 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00055   transformBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize + 2, 1, false)),
00056 #else
00057   transformBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, 1, false)),
00058 #endif
00059   transformBufferSamples(transformBuffer.getData()),
00060   fftWindow(Buffer::hannWindow(fftSize)),
00061   ifftWindow(fftWindow),
00062   fftWindowSamples(fftWindow.getData()),
00063   ifftWindowSamples(ifftWindow.getData()),
00064   fftWindowFactor(fftWindow.sum(0) / fftSize),
00065   windowingBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, 1, false)),
00066   windowingBufferSamples(windowingBuffer.getData())
00067 {
00068   static int announced = 0;
00069   
00070   ugen_assert(fftSizeToUse == fftSize); // fftSizeToUse should be a power of 2
00071   
00072   transformBufferSplit.realp = transformBufferSamples;
00073   transformBufferSplit.imagp = transformBufferSamples + fftSizeHalved;
00074   
00075 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00076   if(!announced) printf("FFTEngine using FFTW\n"); announced = 1;
00077   fftwPlan = fftwf_plan_dft_r2c_1d(fftSize, transformBufferSamples, (fftwf_complex*) transformBufferSamples, FFTW_ESTIMATE);
00078   ifftwPlan = fftwf_plan_dft_c2r_1d(fftSize, (fftwf_complex*) transformBufferSamples, transformBufferSamples, FFTW_ESTIMATE);
00079 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)
00080   if(!announced) printf("FFTEngine using FFTReal\n"); announced = 1;
00081   fftReal = new FFTReal<float>(fftSize);
00082 #else
00083   if(!announced) printf("FFTEngine using vDSP\n"); announced = 1;
00084   fftSizeLog2 = 4;
00085   while((1 << fftSizeLog2) < fftSize)
00086     fftSizeLog2++;
00087   fftvDSP = vDSP_create_fftsetup (fftSizeLog2, 0);
00088 #endif
00089   
00090   //printf("fftsize=%d\n", fftSize);
00091 }

00093 FFTEngineInternal::~FFTEngineInternal()
00094 {
00095 #ifdef UGEN_FFTW
00096   fftwf_destroy_plan(fftwPlan);
00097   fftwf_destroy_plan(ifftwPlan);
00098 #elif defined(UGEN_FFTREAL)

00110 void FFTEngineInternal::fft(Buffer const& outputBuffer, 
00111               Buffer const& inputBuffer, 
00112               const bool applyWindow,
00113               const int outputChannel,
00114               const int inputChannel) throw()
00115 {
00116   if((outputBuffer.size() < fftSize) || (inputBuffer.size() < fftSize))
00117   {
00118     printf("FFTEngineInternal::fft() - buffer(s) too small\n");
00119     return;
00120   }
00121   
00122   DSPSplitComplex fftBuffer;
00123   fftBuffer.realp = Buffer(outputBuffer).getData(outputChannel);
00124   fftBuffer.imagp = fftBuffer.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00125   
00126   fft(fftBuffer, inputBuffer.getData(inputChannel), applyWindow);
00127 }

00129 void FFTEngineInternal::fft(Buffer const& outputBuffer, 
00130               Buffer const& inputBuffer, 
00131               const bool applyWindow,
00132               const int outputChannel,
00133               const int inputChannel,
00134               const int outputOffset,
00135               const int inputOffset) throw()
00136 { 
00137   DSPSplitComplex fftBuffer;
00138   fftBuffer.realp = Buffer(outputBuffer).getData(outputChannel) + outputOffset;
00139   fftBuffer.imagp = fftBuffer.realp + fftSizeHalved;
00140   
00141   fft(fftBuffer, inputBuffer.getData(inputChannel) + inputOffset, applyWindow); 
00142 }

00144 void FFTEngineInternal::fft(DSPSplitComplex& outputBuffer, const float* const inputBuffer, const bool applyWindow) throw()
00145 {   
00146   if(applyWindow)
00147   {
00148     int numSamples = fftSize;
00149     const float *inputSamples = inputBuffer;
00150     float *tempSamples = windowingBufferSamples;
00151     const float *windowSamples = this->fftWindowSamples;
00152     while(numSamples--)
00153     {
00154       *tempSamples++ = *inputSamples++ * *windowSamples++;
00155     }
00156     fft(outputBuffer, windowingBufferSamples);
00157   }
00158   else
00159     fft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer);
00160   
00161 }

00163 void FFTEngineInternal::ifft(Buffer const& outputBuffer, 
00164                Buffer const& inputBuffer, 
00165                const bool applyWindow, 
00166                const bool applyScaling,
00167                const int outputChannel,
00168                const int inputChannel) throw()
00169 {

00199 void FFTEngineInternal::ifft(float* const outputBuffer, DSPSplitComplex const& inputBuffer, const bool applyWindow, const bool applyScaling) throw()
00200 {
00201   ifft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer);
00202   
00203   if(applyWindow && applyScaling)
00204   {
00205     int numSamples = fftSize;
00206     float *outputSamples = outputBuffer;
00207     float *windowSamples = this->ifftWindowSamples;
00208     while(numSamples--)
00209     {
00210       *outputSamples++ *= *windowSamples++ * ifftScaling;
00211     }     
00212   }
00213   else if(applyWindow)
00214   {
00215     int numSamples = fftSize;
00216     float *outputSamples = outputBuffer;
00217     float *windowSamples = this->ifftWindowSamples;
00218     while(numSamples--)
00219     {
00220       *outputSamples++ *= *windowSamples++;
00221     }
00222   }
00223   else if(applyScaling)
00224   {
00225     int numSamples = fftSize;
00226     float *outputSamples = outputBuffer;
00227     while(numSamples--)
00228     {
00229       *outputSamples++ *= ifftScaling;
00230     } 
00231   }
00232 }

00234 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToRealImagRawSplit(Buffer const& raw) throw()
00235 {
00236   if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00237   { 
00238     ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00239     return Buffer();
00240   }
00241 
00242   Buffer splitBuffer;
00243   for(int i = 0; i < raw.getNumChannels(); i++)
00244   {
00245     splitBuffer <<= raw.getRegion(0, fftSizeHalved-1, i, i);
00246     splitBuffer <<= raw.getRegion(fftSizeHalved, fftSize-1, i, i);
00247   }
00248   
00249   return splitBuffer;
00250 }

00252 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToRealImagUnpacked(Buffer const& raw) throw()
00253 {
00254   if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00255   { 
00256     ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00257     return Buffer();
00258   }
00259   
00260   Buffer zeros(BufferSpec(1, raw.getNumChannels(), true));
00261   return (raw.getRegion(0, fftSizeHalved),zeros, raw.getRegion(fftSizeHalved+1, fftSize-1), zeros);
00262 }

00264 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToRealImagUnpacked(Buffer const& raw, const int firstBin, const int numBins) throw()
00265 {
00266   if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00267   { 
00268     ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00269     return Buffer();
00270   }
00271   
00272   Buffer unpacked = rawToRealImagUnpacked(raw);
00273   
00274   if(firstBin != 0 || (firstBin + numBins) < fftSizeHalved)
00275   {
00276     Buffer temp = unpacked;
00277     unpacked = temp.getRegion(firstBin, firstBin + numBins - 1);    
00278     unpacked = (unpacked, temp.getRegion(firstBin + fftSizeHalved + 1, firstBin + fftSizeHalved + numBins));
00279   }
00280   
00281   return unpacked;
00282 }

00284 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToRealImagUnpackedSplit(Buffer const& raw, const int firstBin, const int numBins) throw()
00285 {
00286   if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00287   { 
00288     ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00289     return Buffer();
00290   }
00291   
00292   ugen_assert(firstBin >= 0);
00293   ugen_assert(numBins > 0);
00294   
00295   Buffer splitBuffer;
00296   
00297   for(int i = 0; i < raw.getNumChannels(); i++)
00298   {
00299     splitBuffer <<= raw.getRegion(0, fftSizeHalved, i, i);
00300     splitBuffer <<= (B(0.f), raw.getRegion(fftSizeHalved+1, fftSize-1, i, i), B(0.f));
00301   }
00302   
00303   return splitBuffer.getRegion(firstBin, firstBin + numBins - 1);
00304 }

00306 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToMagnitudePhase(Buffer const& raw, 
00307                         const int firstBin, 
00308                         const int numBins, 
00309                         const bool magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT) throw()
00310 {
00311   if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00312   { 
00313     ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00314     return Buffer();
00315   }
00316   
00317   ugen_assert(firstBin >= 0);
00318   ugen_assert(numBins > 0);
00319   
00320   const int firstRealBin = firstBin;
00321   const int firstImagBin = firstBin + fftSizeHalved + 1;
00322   
00323   Buffer unpacked = rawToRealImagUnpacked(raw);
00324   
00325   Buffer real(unpacked.getRegion(firstRealBin, firstRealBin + numBins - 1));
00326   Buffer imag(unpacked.getRegion(firstImagBin, firstImagBin + numBins - 1));
00327   
00328   Buffer magnitude(hypot(imag, real));
00329   
00330   if(magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT)
00331     magnitude = magnitude * (1.0 / (fftSizeHalved * fftWindowFactor));
00332   else
00333     magnitude = magnitude * (1.0 / fftSizeHalved);
00334   
00335   Buffer phase(atan2(imag, real));
00336   
00337   return (magnitude, phase);
00338 }

00340 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToMagnitudePhaseSplit(Buffer const& raw, 
00341                            const int firstBin, 
00342                            const int numBins, 
00343                            const bool magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT) throw()
00344 {
00345   if(raw.size() != fftSize) 
00346   { 
00347     ugen_assertfalse; // raw data wrong size
00348     return Buffer();
00349   }
00350   
00351   ugen_assert(firstBin >= 0);
00352   ugen_assert(numBins > 0);
00353   
00354   const int firstRealBin = firstBin;
00355   const int firstImagBin = firstBin + fftSizeHalved + 1;
00356   
00357   Buffer unpacked = rawToRealImagUnpacked(raw);
00358   
00359   Buffer real(unpacked.getRegion(firstRealBin, firstRealBin + numBins - 1));
00360   Buffer imag(unpacked.getRegion(firstImagBin, firstImagBin + numBins - 1));
00361   
00362   Buffer magnitude(hypot(imag, real));
00363   
00364   if(magnitudeAssumesWindowedFFT)
00365     magnitude = magnitude * (1.0 / (fftSizeHalved * fftWindowFactor));
00366   else

00381 Buffer FFTEngineInternal::rawToMagnitude(Buffer const& raw, 
00382                      const int firstBin,

00385 {
